parties.petitioner: Mypreferred Transformation & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. & Anr.

summary: Limitation for filing Section 34 application; 3-month period expired 29.05.2022, condonable 30-day period expired 28.06.2022 during court vacation; application filed 04.07.2022 on reopening; Section 4 of Limitation Act not applicable to condonable period; Section 10 of GCA inapplicable; reliance on Assam Urban and Bhimashankar precedent; delay not condoned; appeal dismissed; current law bars relief despite practical hardship.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; application held barred by limitation; no condonation of delay; execution stay vacated.
